scenarioUse: Support at Home coordination qualification source; not an eligibility determination.

controls.requirement: An aged-care assessment determines approved services and produces a Notice of Decision with reasons and review information.
The support plan records the assessed needs and approved services that govern subsequent care planning.
The consumer chooses a provider and supplies the referral code that permits that provider to access the client record and support plan.
Care management coordinates services against the support plan and changes in the person's needs.
